title: 找到冠军 II
summary: n 支队伍的有向边 [u,v] 表示 u 强于 v；若恰有一支队伍没有任何更强对手则返回它，否则返回负一。
insight: 任何有入边的节点都至少输给过一支队伍，不可能成为冠军；反之，入度为零正好表示没有已知队伍比它更强。因此只需标记所有边的终点，再检查未被标记的节点是否唯一。
pitfalls: 边的起点是强队，终点才是被击败的队伍
孤立节点同样是零入度，可能导致冠军不唯一
找到第二个零入度节点时应返回负一

solutions.title: 唯一零入度节点
solutions.idea: 标记所有被击败过的队伍并寻找唯一未被标记者。
steps: 创建 defeated[n] 布尔数组
对每条边 [u,v] 标记 defeated[v]=true
扫描所有队伍；遇到未被标记者时，若已有 candidate 则返回负一，否则记录它

code.java: class Solution { public int findChampion(int n,int[][] edges){boolean[] defeated=new boolean[n];for(int[] edge:edges)defeated[edge[1]]=true;int candidate=-1;for(int team=0;team<n;team++)if(!defeated[team]){if(candidate!=-1)return -1;candidate=team;}return candidate;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun findChampion(n:Int,edges:Array<IntArray>):Int{val defeated=BooleanArray(n);for(edge in edges)defeated[edge[1]]=true;var candidate=-1;for(team in 0 until n)if(!defeated[team]){if(candidate!=-1)return -1;candidate=team};return candidate} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:int findChampion(int n,vector<vector<int>>& edges){vector<char> defeated(n);for(auto& edge:edges)defeated[edge[1]]=true;int candidate=-1;for(int team=0;team<n;++team)if(!defeated[team]){if(candidate!=-1)return -1;candidate=team;}return candidate;} };
